subtitle: Workspace reservations
title: Finish the shared work plan
intro: Reserve your own workspace for Monday and Tuesday, and finish Taylor’s Wednesday entry as requested. Review the coordinator’s incoming draft, then save the roster. These reservations record physical work locations; the team’s video meeting link works from every listed workspace.
notice: All setups are approved for the same work, pay, hours, privacy, equipment and connectivity. Both your office and remote desk are available at no charge, with no difference in travel time for this week. Taylor’s note: “Please put my Wednesday entry at my remote workspace for the full day.”
